name: hunt
description: Recover the byte-exact master behind any CDN/CMS transform, and recover assets from dead, parked, redirected, or archive-only websites. Two skills over one vendored engine: a 48-resolver master-image pipeline (proxy peeling, param stripping, clamp-vs-upscale tests, no-webp Accept, WAF impersonation) and a dead-site triage tree (DNS/CT/CDX recon, four-way liveness read, open-index enumeration, Wayback id_ raw recovery). Carries a trap catalog for every way a candidate wins on bytes or format while carrying fewer real pixels. Verifies before it believes; never claims a dead end without the disproving evidence. Recon emits recon.json (schema 1) — every host tagged with the evidence that found it — and fingerprints dead storefronts, handing those off to the `wayback-archive` plugin for full catalog recovery rather than hand-rolling one.
